name: cpvts
description: CPVTS — Campus Parking & Vehicle Tracking System

scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cpvts/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cpvts/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cpvts/api && npm run build -w @cpvts/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @cpvts/shared" "npm run dev -w @cpvts/api" "npm run dev -w @cpvts/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @cpvts/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @cpvts/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
